sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Amendment Act 1987
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1987
ACT II OF 1987
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH COMMISSION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1987
An Act to amend the
Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th June, 1987]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 9th June, 1987, and are hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This
Act may be called the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission
(Amendment) Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XX of 1981

ACT II OF 1987
ACT II OF 1987
PAKISTAN SPACE AND UPPER ATMOSPHERE RESEARCH COMMISSION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1987
An Act to amend the
Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission Ordinance, 1981.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th June, 1987]
The following Acts of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 9th June, 1987, and are hereby published for
general information:--
2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XX of 1981.--In the Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research
Commission Ordinance, 1981 (XX of 1981), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 2,---
(a) in clause (f), the word
"and", at the end, shall be omitted ; and
(b) after clause (f), amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause shall
be inserted, namely :---
(ff) "President" mean
"President of the Council; and"
